verdict.rationale: A training-data opt-out is a policy control for services that collect user data, and a discrete GPU does not ingest user data for model training, so this axis does not apply to the RTX 5070 Ti. The marketing line about AI models running "fully private" on an RTX PC describes local inference, not a documented opt-out from training. It therefore does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
